postalService.title: India Postal Service
postalService.description: India Post, with its 170-year legacy, is the largest and most trusted postal network in the country. Operating across 23 postal circles, it ensures efficient delivery of letters, parcels, and financial services to every corner of India.

pincode.title: Pincode
pincode.description: Easily find the Pincode for any location in India. Just enter the address, and get accurate, location-based results to ensure your mail reaches its destination hassle-free.

postage.title: Calculate Postage
postage.description: Plan your deliveries effortlessly! Use the postage calculator to estimate shipping costs by entering your package details.

postOffice.title: Nearest Post Office
postOffice.description: Locate the nearest post office quickly and conveniently. Enter your Pincode to access detailed directions.

awareness.title: Postal Awareness
awareness.subtitle: Understanding the basics of India Post services and proper addressing

steps.heading: Recipient's Name
steps.description: Write the full name clearly on the first line

steps.heading: Building & Street
steps.description: Include house/flat number and street name

steps.heading: Area & Landmark
steps.description: Mention area name and nearby landmark

steps.heading: City & PIN Code
steps.description: Write city name followed by correct 6-digit PIN code

steps.heading: State & Country
steps.description: End with state name and country

tips.heading: Important Tips
items: Use block letters for PIN code
Include return address on the back

items.heading: Heavy Items
items.description: Use strong boxes and reinforced packaging tape
